Post-`earthborn-statuelike-boutu` (e9d5) census, at HEAD 93ca75365f61:

**Seams are NOT eliminated — e9d5 deliberately did not rewire any producer.**
e9d5's own commit message states "production continues constructing legacy dict payloads
unchanged (AC7); no producer is rewired." Confirmed no reference to `Observation`/`TicketPlan`/
`mutation_payloads`/`payload_shadow` exists anywhere in `outbound_differ.py`,
`outbound_mutation_builders.py`, or `outbound_field_diff.py` (grep: zero hits).

Current signatures (re-counted at this HEAD, line numbers shifted slightly from the audited
snapshot but shapes are unchanged):
- `_compute_outbound_update_mutation` (`outbound_mutation_builders.py:166`): 18 positional +
  6 keyword-only = **24 total loose values**. Confirmed still present.
- `compute_update_fields` (`outbound_field_diff.py:235`): 2 positional + 12 keyword-only =
  **14 total**. Confirmed still present.
- `diff_canonical_fields` (`outbound_field_diff.py:303`): 3 positional + 8 keyword-only =
  **11 total**. Confirmed still present.

Real convergence work is required (not already done as a side effect of e9d5). Disposition:
proceeding with the Approach's cohesive-input-bundle design — a per-pass-invariant context
(binding_store, client, pass_id, mapping/repo_root/effective_cache, outbound_mapper,
inbound_mapper, links, jira_snapshot, prev_snapshot, local_label_intent,
_selected_for_get_this_pass, local_ticket_types, local_parents, _assignee_resolver — all fixed
once per `compute_outbound_mutations` pass and identical across every ticket in the loop) plus a
separate mutable-sinks bundle (absent_alive_fields, conflict_sink, dropped_field_sink — the
pass's diagnostic side-channel outputs), converging the update-mutation builder's per-call
argument count from 24 down to ~7 (mutations, ticket, status, local_id, jira_key, ctx, sinks).
Mirroring the same context object into `compute_update_fields`/`diff_canonical_fields` converges
those seams similarly. No generic `Mapping[str, Any]` option bag — each bundle is a single
frozen dataclass whose fields form one real invariant (pass-scoped collaborators vs. pass-scoped
mutable sinks), matching the ticket's explicit constraint. Production routing, retry/idempotency/
fuse/transport ownership, and legacy-route deletion are untouched (owned by `single-vast-roan`).
